title: Van Tassel's contact with Venusians
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Van Tassel's contact with Venusians, about 1950s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: George Van Tassel saying that he was dealing with Venusians

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says on Jesse Michels's podcast that in the 1950s an American man, George Van Tassel, claimed he was dealing with beings from the planet Venus. Jorjani brings it up as part of his argument that non-human beings have shaped human religion and belief, which is what it would mean if such contacts were real.
